summary.para: Gets or sets a value that indicates the maximum number of allowable characters in an Open XML part. A zero (0) value indicates that there are no limits on the size of the part. A non-zero value specifies the maximum size, in characters.

This property allows you to mitigate denial of service attacks where the attacker submits a package with an extremely large Open XML part. By limiting the size of the part, you can detect the attack and recover reliably.

member.name: M:Kumo.Range.Valid

summary.para: Gets a value indicating whether this Range is valid.

A range is considered valid if it spans a sequence of neighboring runs. Runs are considered neighbors if they are within the same paragraph or directly neighboring paragraphs and there are no other runs between them.
For example, the following ranges are not valid:

list.item: - A range that starts within a main body paragraph but ends inside a table paragraph.
- A range that spans multiple table cells.

summary.para: Only valid ranges can be annotated.

member.returns: The value indicating whether this range is valid or not.
